---
title: "Author with the AI co-pilot"
subtitle: "AIPLA teacher guide — T4"
---

::: callout-note
## Where this fits

The AI **co-pilot** lives inside the activity builder (guide *T2*). Instead of
filling in every field by hand, you describe what you want to teach and the
co-pilot proposes a teaching goal and workspace elements. You review each
proposal and decide what to keep. Nothing changes until you approve it.
:::

## What the co-pilot does

The co-pilot (labelled **Medbygger**) reads a plain-language description of your
lesson and drafts:

- a **teaching goal** (the Socratic prompt the tutor follows),
- **workspace elements** — a checklist, a note, a table, a calculator, and so
  on, and
- suggested **curriculum materials** to attach (guide *T3*).

Each suggestion arrives as a **proposal** you can apply, edit, or dismiss. You
stay in control: the co-pilot never changes the activity on its own.

## Step 1 — Open the builder

Create or open an activity (guide *T2*). The co-pilot panel sits at the
**bottom-right** of the builder. It opens ready for a description.

![The co-pilot panel (Medbygger) sits at the bottom-right of the activity builder.](assets/t4-01-copilot-panel.png)

## Step 2 — Describe what you want to teach

Type a short description — for example, *"energy conservation for a 2.g class,
with a checklist and a worked example"* — and select **Send**. The co-pilot
thinks for a moment, then returns one or more proposals.

## Step 3 — Review each proposal

Each proposal is a card: a suggested teaching goal, a checklist, a note, a table,
and so on. For each one you can:

- **Anvend** (Apply) — accept the suggestion into your draft,
- **Rediger** (Edit) — adjust it first, then apply, or
- **Afvis** (Dismiss) — reject it.

![Each suggestion is a proposal card you can apply, edit, or dismiss.](assets/t4-02-proposal.png)

## Step 4 — Apply and refine

When you apply a proposal, it drops into the matching field of the builder —
and stays fully editable. Applied suggestions are marked so you can see what the
co-pilot contributed. Keep refining by hand, or ask for more.

![Applied suggestions land in the builder and remain editable.](assets/t4-03-applied.png)

When the activity looks right, **save** it as usual (guide *T2*). Nothing the
co-pilot proposed is live until you save the activity.

::: callout-tip
The co-pilot proposes; you dispose. Every change waits for your **Anvend**
(Apply), and even applied changes remain editable before you save — so it is
safe to explore its suggestions freely.
:::

## Next steps

- Attach source documents the tutor can cite — *T3 — Add and organise
  curriculum materials*.
- Share the activity with students — *T1 — Set up a class and share it*.
